builder_plan.scenario: A multi-step product task fails because the agent loses track of dependencies.
builder_plan.change: Try the proposed planning step on tasks with checkable intermediate outcomes.
builder_plan.baseline: The same agent solving the same tasks without the new planning step.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Task completion, unnecessary steps, planning tokens, response time, and total cost.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: The Between-Round Decision in Autonomous Research: An LLM Controller That Reads the Whole Trajectory
summary: Replaces rule-based, score-based, or search-tree controllers in autonomous research loops with a single LLM call that reads full trajectory history to decide whether to refine the current champion or start a new direction. Costs one additional LLM inference per experimental round plus the context window capacity to hold accumulated evidence, which grows with trajectory length. Can fail when the trajectory history exceeds effective context limits, when the LLM misjudges which past solution to build from, or when the domain lacks clear verified metrics for the controller to ground its decisions.
rationale: The method is API-accessible and requires no training, but its gains depend on the specific research loop and task, so the reader should validate it on their own workload before production adoption.
technique: LLM Controller for Between-Round Research Decisions

claims.statement: Replaces rule-based, score-based, or search-tree controllers in autonomous research loops with a single LLM call that reads full trajectory history to decide whether to refine the current champion or start a new direction. Costs one additional LLM inference per experimental round plus the context window capacity to hold accumulated evidence, which grows with trajectory length. Can fail when the trajectory history exceeds effective context limits, when the LLM misjudges which past solution to build from, or when the domain lacks clear verified metrics for the controller to ground its decisions.
Improves task baselines by 4.80% MAE on ETTh1, 3.44 points on SST-2, and 3.43 points on CIFAR-100; on depression detection reaches 0.6164 macro-F1, 5.5 points above baseline.
